english: Let $\alpha=-\dfrac{1+\sqrt{5}}{4}$. Considering only the principal values of the inverse trigonometric functions, the value of $\sin^{-1}\alpha+\cos^{-1}\left(2\alpha^{2}-1\right)$ is
hindi: माना कि $\alpha=-\dfrac{1+\sqrt{5}}{4}$ है। प्रतिलोम त्रिकोणमितीय फलनों के केवल मुख्य मानों को लेते हुए, $\sin^{-1}\alpha+\cos^{-1}\left(2\alpha^{2}-1\right)$ का मान है
solution_full: The number $\dfrac{1+\sqrt{5}}{4}$ is the standard value $\cos36^{\circ}$ (equivalently, $\sin18^{\circ}=\dfrac{\sqrt{5}-1}{4}$ and $\cos36^{\circ}=1-2\sin^{2}18^{\circ}=\dfrac{1+\sqrt{5}}{4}$). Hence $\alpha=-\cos36^{\circ}=-\sin54^{\circ}$.

Since $\sin^{-1}$ is odd and $54^{\circ}=\dfrac{3\pi}{10}$ lies in $\left[-\dfrac{\pi}{2},\dfrac{\pi}{2}\right]$, $\sin^{-1}\alpha=-\sin^{-1}(\sin54^{\circ})=-\dfrac{3\pi}{10}$. (Taking $\sin^{-1}\alpha=-\dfrac{\pi}{5}$ confuses $\cos36^{\circ}$ with $\sin36^{\circ}$.)

Because $72^{\circ}=\dfrac{2\pi}{5}\in[0,\pi]$, $\cos^{-1}\left(2\alpha^{2}-1\right)=\dfrac{2\pi}{5}$. The identity $\cos^{-1}(2x^{2}-1)=2\cos^{-1}x$ holds only for $x\in[0,1]$; here $\alpha<0$ and $2\cos^{-1}\alpha=2\cdot\dfrac{4\pi}{5}=\dfrac{8\pi}{5}$ is outside the principal range, so it cannot be used.
originality_note: New: the argument -(1+sqrt5)/4 must be recognised as -cos36 = -sin54, and the double-angle argument 2a^2-1 as cos72 = sin18, so both principal-value traps (sin^-1 of -cos36, and cos^-1(2x^2-1) = 2cos^-1 x failing for negative x) act together (way 5). Closest known: evaluation exercises like cos^-1(cos 7pi/6) or sin^-1 of a single non-standard value. Different because: the value is hidden in a double-angle composite with a negative argument.

concept_use.Evaluation of inverse trigonometric expr: sin^-1(alpha) = -3pi/10 and cos^-1(2alpha^2-1) = 2pi/5 are evaluated with principal ranges, rejecting 2cos^-1(alpha).
concept_use.Ratios of non-standard angles: 15, 18, 2: Recognising (1+sqrt5)/4 = cos36 and (sqrt5-1)/4 = sin18 = cos72 is what makes both evaluations possible.

Checked the options are all of one form (multiples of pi) and only (C) equals pi/10; distractors are the sign slip, the cos36/sin36 confusion and the 2cos^-1 alpha trap. Changed: No change.
key_step: Recognising alpha = -cos36 = -sin54 and 2alpha^2-1 = cos72, then using principal ranges.
justification: Two non-standard-angle recognitions chained with a principal-value check; routine multi-step with no real insight once the values are known. Same demand as 2026-P1-Q4 (L2), cot^-1(cot(-11)) with range shift plus evaluation.
